name: ctags
description: Universal source code indexer supporting 50+ programming languages

ctags.description: Multi-language source indexer with advanced pattern recognition
ctags.usage:
ctags -R --exclude=node_modules . # Recursive indexing excluding node_modules
ctags --languages=+Python,-JavaScript src/ # Include Python, exclude JavaScript
ctags --extras=+r --fields=+iaS --kinds-c=+p *.c # Enhanced C tags with prototypes
ctags --output-format=json --fields=* -o tags.json *.py # JSON output format
ctags --list-maps # Show file extension mappings

readtags.description: Tag file reader with filtering, sorting, and formatting capabilities
readtags.usage:
readtags -t tags main # Find 'main' function definitions
readtags -Q '(and (eq? $kind "function") (prefix? $name "get_"))' -l # Find getter functions
readtags -S -F '#{$name}#{$line}' -l # Custom format sorted output
readtags -e -Q '(eq? $input "main.c")' -l # Tags from specific file
readtags --help # Show all query expressions and formats
